implementedPieces: Domain layer (src/domain) kernel primitives and policy/PDP building blocks, test-verified
Application layer (src/application) pipeline, commit service and request handler composition, test-verified
Adapters layer (src/adapters) — a Postgres commit adapter over the S1 Postgres/RLS/transaction/outbox/audit substrate
Delivery layer (src/delivery) — framework-neutral ASGI host-boundary primitives and standard router composition
CreateCustomer-specific golden-slice composition chain (HTTP message adapter, pipeline, request handler, ASGI composition) test-verified end to end at the primitive layer

P07 generic renderActionSdk(contract) generator (tools/generate-action-sdk.mjs) consuming an exact P02 ActionContract instance, rendering a framework-neutral, import-free ESM SDK module for arbitrary action contracts, test-verified
ASGI host-boundary profile (core profile, conformance, scope/encoder rules) test-verified
Python host app factory and optional Uvicorn/Hypercorn host runners with explicit CLI selection (host/python_asgi, not src/delivery)
PostgreSQL-backed transaction/outbox/audit substrate test-verified in isolation

P04 policy-as-data candidate resolution, sequential batch evaluation and a decision-log adapter, composed end to end with a real PostgreSQL decision-log (chain-hashed, tenant-attested) via policyDecisionLogComposition, test-verified against PostgreSQL 16

P05 UoW (UnitOfWork), canonical CommitReceipt and the write envelope wiring the unit-of-work port to a real commit boundary, composed end to end into the CreateCustomer commit-boundary composition chain, test-verified

P08 versioned SDK distribution: tools/generate-versioned-action-sdk-distribution.mjs (renderVersionedActionSdkDistribution(contract, distributionVersion)) wraps P07's renderActionSdk with a caller-supplied Kernel distribution version, distinct from the action's own contract version, into a coordinate-addressed, integrity-checked manifest+module file set; test-verified, targeted 27/27 GREEN, no npm publish/release

P09 clean SDK consumer conformance: a standalone, builtins-only clean consumer fixture (tests/fixtures/versioned-sdk-clean-consumer.mjs) copies P08's real versioned SDK distribution payload into a temp directory, empties the environment, and validates the distribution version, module path, manifest shape, module file existence and the exact recomputed SHA-256 before importing it; test-verified; no npm publish/release

P10 app-core: an app-owned Customer app-core public-SDK consumer boundary (consumers/customer-app-core/customer-app-core.mjs, CUSTOMER_APP_CORE_MANIFEST plus createCustomerAppCore) that composes a P08-generated public action SDK module only through its public contract surface at an exact SDK-derived coordinate, fails closed on a missing/malformed/wrong-coordinate SDK or a missing/near-match customer:core capability grant (default-deny), and exposes no schema/adapter/CRUD/Surface/UI/host/release/readiness behavior; test-verified

P11 app-owned customer schema: a pure, zero-import, application-owned customer_records schema and validator contract (consumers/customer-app-core/customer-records-schema.mjs, CUSTOMER_RECORDS_SCHEMA plus canonicalizeCustomerRecord) that deep-freezes its six-field/index/RLS/runtime-grant descriptor and canonicalizes/validates an exact-six-key record fail-closed, with no SQL, migration, adapter, CRUD, or cutover behavior; test-verified

P12 app-owned adapter: an application-owned, query-injected customer_records adapter (consumers/customer-app-core/customer-records-adapter.mjs, createCustomerRecordsAdapter) that canonicalizes a record against the P11 schema/validator contract, requires a matching tenantId, and issues exactly one parameterized INSERT via a caller-supplied query function, with no real database connection, migration, cutover, or CRUD read/update/delete behavior; test-verified
notImplementedPieces: data cutover and rollback (P13) plus a real database connection/wiring and application-owned persistence, beyond the P12 query-injected adapter
outbox relay lifecycle (P18) actually delivering events out of the transactional outbox
production proof: no HA/DR, security, performance or promotion gate evidence exists yet (P19-P25)
currentTruth.notRunnableProductClaim: No SaaS user journey (form submit -> save -> reject -> retry) is runnable end-to-end today. A CreateCustomer-specific golden-slice chain spanning Domain, Application, Adapters and Delivery is test-verified in isolation, P07's generic renderActionSdk generator plus P08's versioned SDK distribution wrapper exist over the exact P02 ActionContract, P09's clean-consumer conformance proof exists over P08's real distribution payload, P10's app-core public-SDK consumer boundary exists, P11's app-owned customer schema/validator contract exists, and P12's application-owned, query-injected adapter now exists, but data cutover/rollback, a real database connection, Kernel cleanup and a product Surface remain absent to make it runnable as a real product.

families.dod: Current-truth + roadmap artifact is test-verified, budget-compliant and owner-legible; it is the sole machine-readable owner of roadmap state.
Kernel primitive + policy/authorization/PDP public contract building blocks are test-verified in isolation with every stronger readiness flag held false.
A generic SDK generator and versioned distribution, with clean consumer conformance proven, land test-verified with no product code touched.
app-core and application-owned persistence (app-owned customer schema, adapter, cutover/rollback, Kernel cleanup) land test-verified end to end.
A real product slice — Customer module typed API and a separate Surface/UI projection — is demonstrably runnable, not just test-verified in isolation.
Installable delivery host adapters and the outbox relay lifecycle land test-verified, each import-side-effect-free and fail-closed, delivering events.
Enterprise operation readiness — observability/SLO, performance, security, deploy package/staging, HA/DR/upgrade rollback — lands test-verified.
External proof by three independent consumer teams and the full promotion gate set land test-verified; gapClosed can be evaluated for the first time.
